## 说明

该函数返回所有图表文字使用的字体。字体按操作系统选择，以便正确显示中文：macOS上为"Songti SC"，Windows上为"SimSun"，Linux上为"Noto Serif CJK SC"。如果该字体未安装，则使用下一个可用的中文字体（都没有时使用"sans"）。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function returns the font used for all chart text. The font is chosen
for the operating system so that Chinese text displays correctly: "Songti SC"
on macOS, "SimSun" on Windows and "Noto Serif CJK SC" on Linux. If that font
is not installed, the next available Chinese font is used.

</details>

## 用法

```r
fao_font(family = NULL)
```

## 参数

`family`
:   可选，从现在起（在本次R会话中）使用的字体族，如"Microsoft YaHei"。默认为NULL，即不改变字体，只返回当前字体。也可以用`options(faofishingreport.font = "...")`设置字体。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    Optional font family to use from now on, e.g. "Microsoft YaHei".
    The choice can also be set with `options(faofishingreport.font = "...")`.

    </details>

## 返回值

字体族的名称。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

The font family name.

</details>

## 另请参阅

Other settings and language:
`fao_settings()`,
`fao_translate()`

## 示例

```r
fao_font()                    # font chosen for this computer
fao_font("Microsoft YaHei")   # use another font
```
